issues.legal_issue: A plaint may be amended to add an inconsistent alternative plea where the plea is supported by the opposing party’s pleadings and causes no prejudice, provided the amendment does not introduce an entirely new cause of action or otherwise violate the limits on amendment.
The bar under Order IX Rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure applies only when a later suit is founded on the same cause of action as an earlier suit dismissed for default.

A mortgagor’s recurring right to redeem a subsisting mortgage is not barred from being pursued in a later suit merely because an earlier redemption suit was dismissed for default, unless the right of redemption has been extinguished or the later suit is time-barred.
